description:
Market-wide DAILY FII/DII net cash-flow (Rs crore), NSE cash (Capital Market) segment.

    NOT the shareholding data: get_shareholding gives per-company QUARTERLY FII/DII holding
    PERCENTAGES; this gives market-wide DAILY net buy/sell/net value in Rs crore -- e.g. "FIIs
    net sold Rs 2,340 Cr, DIIs net bought Rs 1,890 Cr" for a given trading day. `from_date`/
    `to_date` are optional ISO dates (default: trailing ~30 days); `segment` is "cash" only.
    For NSE participant-wise F&O positioning, use `get_fo_participant_activity`. Raw exchange-
    published figures; `net = buy - sell` is the only computation (SEBI-RA line — no direction
    calls or "smart money" framing).
    The envelope's `source` reflects actual per-call provenance, not a fixed NSE label: recent
    dates are NSE-live (`source="nse"`), older dates are Moneycontrol-backfilled
    (`source="moneycontrol"`, since NSE publishes no bulk cash-history archive), and a query
    window spanning both returns `source="mixed"` (each row still carries its own accurate
    `source`).

    Renamed from `get_fii_dii_flow` (issue #285) so the name itself telegraphs scope
    (MARKET-wide) against its get_sector_fii_flow/get_stock_fii_flow siblings.
    `get_fii_dii_flow` is kept as a deprecated back-compat alias for this release.
name: get_market_fii_dii_flow
